name: HIGHSTAR TECHNOLOOGY PRIVATE LIMITED
india_angle: Highstar Technology has a manufacturing facility with a 7500 sq.ft. area in India, capable of producing ESD workstations and chairs.
summary: Highstar Technology Private Limited specializes in manufacturing ESD control and cleanroom products, serving industries including electronics and semiconductors. They provide turnkey solutions for ESD control plans and have a significant manufacturing presence in India.
